unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops three bridges: 'Caring but little for the name, and fixed only on tracing the Force', the opener 'This chart of Force was more easily studied…', and the grounds for Aquinas being more scientific. As a result, Adams jumps from 'God or Gods' to the Virgin unmotivated. 'One had but to do…' also has no stated purpose.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'fixed only on tracing the Force' is partly implied by context. 'Thought alone was Form' still supplies the unity argument.

evidence.quote: Caring but little for the name, and fixed only on tracing the Force, Adams had gone straight to the Virgin at Chartres
This chart of Force was more easily studied than any other possible scheme.
Pascal and all the old philosophies called this outside force God or Gods. Adams had gone straight to the Virgin at Chartres.
One had but to do what the Church was always promising to do--abolish in one flash of lightning not only man
Modern science offered not a vestige of proof, or a theory of connection between its forces

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Caring but little for the name, and fixed only on tracing the Force,' and 'This chart of Force was more easily studied than any other possible scheme.' Optionally add 'while St. Thomas at least linked together the joints of his machine.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required: the essential points on the Aquinas comparison and the pantheism steps
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The visit to Chartres reads as piety rather than force-tracing. The pantheism thought-experiment opens mid-thought, and the Haeckel/Mach comparison becomes bare assertion.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Bridges in the Force argument cut, leaving bare consequents

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The source grounds her conviction in her 'feminine lack of interest in all perfections except her own' being honester than science's formula. The revision deletes this and attaches 'carried more conviction' to 'since nothing was easier than to follow her advice'. The first draft had already cut 'though one was quite powerless to ignore it'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The source does chain both clauses, so 'since…' is not invented, only promoted.

evidence.quote: but the Virgin carried more conviction, for her feminine lack of interest in all perfections except her own was honester than the formal phrase of science
The Virgin carried more conviction, however, for her feminine lack of interest in all perfections except her own was honester than the formal phrase of science.
but the Virgin carried more conviction, since nothing was easier than to follow her advice, and turn to Thomas Aquinas.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Reinsert 'for her feminine lack of interest in all perfections except her own was honester than the formal phrase of science;' before 'since'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: planning omission: the plan protects V3 but not this framing irony
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The ironic contrast between the Virgin and British science is lost, along with one of the chapter's sharpest comic characterizations, and the logic subtly changes.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Virgin's greater conviction now rests on a different reason

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts the labyrinth sentence, so 'there' now attaches to 'the trap of logic'. That sentence held the generations content to stay in these labyrinths, pursuing ignorance in silence. The revision also cuts 'supposing society to be ignored, the philosopher was no further forward', so the text jumps from social punishment to 'Nihilism had no bottom.'
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'drag-net of religion' two paragraphs earlier gives 'there' a loose referent.

evidence.quote: Generation after generation of painful and honest-minded scholars had been content to stay in these labyrinths forever
Yet, supposing society to be ignored, the philosopher was no further forward. Nihilism had no bottom.
One had learned from Socrates to distrust, above all other traps, the trap of logic--the mirror of the mind.
Adams felt clear that he could not stop there. The only honest alternative to affirming unity was to deny it

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's sentences: 'Generation after generation… pursuing ignorance in silence. Not one had ever found a logical highroad of escape.' and 'Yet, supposing society to be ignored, the philosopher was no further forward.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required: the trap-of-logic warning and the society/nihilism sequence are essential
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The 'Adams feels clear he cannot stop there' sentence loses its foil: generations who stayed forever. The pivot from social to philosophical denial becomes abrupt.
unresolved_should_improve.title: 'could not stop there' and the jump to nihilism lose their antecedents

unresolved_should_improve.claim: Cutting both gas numbers is authorized. However, the revision removes collision altogether, leaving molecules merely 'flying in right lines'. The multiplicity that the next paragraph equates with Unity is never shown.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'all forms being shifting phases of motion' partly carries the idea. The gas joke was cut consistently, so there is no dangling premise.

evidence.quote: Granting this ocean of colliding atoms, the last hope of humanity, what happened if one dropped the sounder into the abyss
They collided with each other at intervals varying up to 17,750,000 times in a second.
occupied by molecules of gas, flying in right lines. To this analysis--if one understood it right--all matter whatever was reducible.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Change to 'flying in right lines and colliding with each other millions of times in a second.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: optional tradeoff executed, but it compounds the listed risk
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This is the very risk the plan flagged: 'Thus… Unity was… Multiplicity' arrives without its image of incessantly colliding atoms.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Kinetic theory loses its collisions, sharpening the abrupt unity=multiplicity turn

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut several of Adams's self-mockeries. It removed 'the pursuit of ignorance in silence' from the pilgrim sentence and the 'ignorant old man… Death' aside. The revision then also cut 'Here everybody flatly refused help' and the remaining 'pursuing ignorance in silence'. That leaves only the chapter's opening echo of 'ignorance and silence'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'weary pilgrim', 'superficial student', 'mountains of ignorance' and V6 survive.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately the pursuit of ignorance in silence had, by this time, led the weary pilgrim into such mountains of ignorance
an ignorant old man felt no motive for trying to escape, seeing that the only escape possible lay in the form of vis a tergo commonly called Death
Here everybody flatly refused help. Science seemed content with its old phrase of "larger synthesis,"
Science seemed content with its old phrase of "larger synthesis," which was well enough for science, but meant chaos for man.
By this time, unfortunately, the weary pilgrim had come into such mountains of ignorance that he could not even understand a signpost.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Here everybody flatly refused help.' Reword P16 to 'the pursuit of ignorance in silence had led the weary pilgrim into such mountains of ignorance…'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: planning omission: the voice profile names ignorance as method, but no anchor protects its recurrence
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The opening's 'ignorance and silence' motif no longer recurs. The short deflations that punctuate Adams's periodic rhythm are reduced, and the chapter reads more as exposition than as self-ironic confession.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Professed ignorance as method thinned
